candidate_harness.name: H1_scivoi_full

roles.instruction: Estimate continuous scientific utility before treating an action as worth executing.
Estimate reducible epistemic uncertainty and route verification before an irreversible action.

gates: Only proceed when calibrated reliability exceeds threshold.
Do not execute a costly action when conservative net value is non-positive.
Use verification only when epistemic uncertainty is reducible and verification has positive value.

hops.purpose: execute or verify based on net value

rationale: Replace confidence-only ranking with a cost- and failure-aware expected utility contract.
Use ensemble disagreement as epistemic uncertainty and reserve verification for reducible uncertainty.
Make the fallback router executable: retrieve, simulate, or ask according to cost and action type.
Expose provenance, agreement, cost, and reversibility in the action contract.

comparison.rationale: accept only positive utility gain with reliability and worst-regime guards
